par.tr: @color R G B: list of R G B color components in [0..1] range
@color R G B: список R G B цветовых компонент в диапазоне [0..1]
@color name: named color. Possible values are: black, blue, cyan, gold, gray, green, lime, magenta, navy, olive, orange, pink, purple, red, white, yellow, random.
@color name: именованый цвет. Возможные значения: black, blue, cyan, gold, gray, green, lime, magenta, navy, olive, orange, pink, purple, red, white, yellow, random.
